verdict.rationale: Entra ID offers Lifecycle Workflows that 'run automatically against users as they move through their lifecycle', and automatic SCIM provisioning to SaaS apps. Both are automation, but they are limited to identity-governance events, and the evidence never describes scheduling arbitrary recurring jobs. Missing for 10: explicit schedule or recurrence configuration, general-purpose (non-identity) workflow scheduling, documentation of the scheduling mechanics, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
